ninth_hour_darkness.prompt: three crosses standing on the low rocky rise of Golgotha seen from far off, each cross bearing a crucified figure, the whole land swallowed in deep midday darkness, a pale dim sun barely showing through, wide, vertical, 1st-century Judea

face_on_cross.prompt: a close portrait of the crucified Christ from the shoulders up, his thorn-crowned head lifted, eyes open toward heaven, the rough wooden beam behind his head, dim failing light, close, vertical, 1st-century Judea

psalm_scroll_night.prompt: an open scroll of faded illegible script beside a burning clay oil lamp on a rough table at night, warm lamplight, close, vertical, ancient Judea

david_writing_psalm.prompt: an aged king with a grey beard writing on an open scroll by a clay oil lamp, a harp resting against the stone wall beside him, night chamber, warm lamplight, vertical, ancient Israel

risen_christ_congregation.prompt: the risen Christ standing in the midst of a seated congregation of brethren in a lamp-lit stone hall, both arms lifted in praise with smooth open palms, one warm golden shaft falling across Him, upturned faces in wonder, vertical

look_up_faces.prompt: three different upturned 1st-century faces close together in half-light, eyes lifted toward a warm light above, tears catching the light, hope breaking on the faces, vertical

risen_christ_wounds.prompt: the risen Christ standing in radiant dawn light in a garden, white robe, both hands open toward the viewer showing the wounds in his palms, serene living face, vertical, 1st-century Judea

stone_rolled_dawn.prompt: a low rock-cut tomb, its small square opening at ground level pitch dark and empty, the great round stone disc rolled aside, resting against the rock face beside the opening, in a hillside garden at dawn, golden sunrise flooding the garden, vertical, 1st-century Judea

cross_at_dawn.prompt: an empty wooden cross standing on a rocky hilltop against a golden sunrise, warm light flooding the sky, wide, vertical, 1st-century Judea

us_under_cross_shadow.prompt: two bowed figures kneeling small in the dust at dawn, the long shadow of a single cross falling across them and stretching up the ground, heads down and hands clasped, soft low golden light, wide, vertical, 1st-century Judea

golgotha_hill_wide.prompt: a wide view of three crosses standing on the low rocky rise of Golgotha outside the walls of Jerusalem, the crosses short rough wooden posts, the crucified men stripped to plain loincloths with their feet hanging just above the bystanders' heads, the centre cross bearing the crucified Christ, his bare dark hair against the open sky, a crucified thief stripped to a loincloth on each cross beside him, small mourners standing close below, low stone houses with plain flat earthen roofs beyond the wall, the sky a smooth deep black at midday, the hill and city lying dim in deep shadow, wide, vertical, 1st-century Judea

risen_christ_seeking.prompt: The risen Christ standing alive and serene in radiant golden sunrise in a garden, one hand reaching out toward the viewer in gentle invitation, the healed wound-marks visible in his open hand and bare feet, white and earth-toned robes, warm morning light

risen_mercy_hand.prompt: inked biblical graphic-novel of the risen Christ facing forward, one open hand held out low bearing the faint flat healed mark, warm golden light

cross_at_dawn.target: the empty cross on the hilltop

risen_christ_seeking.prompt: A still finished inked graphic-novel illustration on flat canvas, filmed as ONE very slow, gentle push-in toward the whole standing figure, keeping him fully in frame. His face keeps the exact same gentle, calm expression from first frame to last — the eyes, brow and mouth are painted and NEVER shift, harden, frown or blink. The small wound marks on his open palm stay EXACTLY as painted, dry and still — no blood flows, drips, spreads, brightens or grows. Every figure stays perfectly frozen the entire time — no limbs move, no heads turn, no faces change, no morphing, no new figures, hands, wings or objects appear. INVENT NOTHING: show only what is already painted in this exact image. ONLY the light and the garden air are alive: the sunburst behind him slowly intensifies, its rays sweeping gently, warm morning haze shimmers in the light, and the flowers and grasses at the very edges of the frame sway faintly in a light breeze.

risen_christ_congregation.target: the risen Christ standing in the midst of the brethren
risen_christ_congregation.light: the warm lamplight around Him slowly builds and breathes, the single golden shaft widening gently across the hall, soft haze glowing where the light falls
